The structure of Rb2In2Au2 (reduced formula RbInAu) is tetragonal with space group I-4m2 (No. 119) and six atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination throughout: Au and In centers each have four Rb neighbors, while Rb centers have two Au and two In neighbors, with neighbor distances near 2.89–2.90 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show corner-sharing between Au–Au, Au–In, In–In, and Rb–Rb tetrahedra, though these selected patterns do not assert an exclusive sharing type.
